assessment.interpretation: Identical same-page requests are substantially faster after the first. This is consistent with warm prompt/KV prefix reuse; raw backend timings were not collected, so cache attribution is inferred. No explicit cache_prompt product change is justified by this result.
assessment.quality: All three rejected by numeric/date preservation guard; document unchanged. Faster repetitions do not fix fidelity.
assessment.errorCollection: error arrays include cumulative visible conversation errors, not multiple errors from the individual request.

limitations: Three identical requests in one desktop Playwright WebKit CPU session; no statistical or physical-device generalization.
No provider raw completion, token usage, cache counters or prefill/decode phase timings.
Does not establish cache reuse for changed tasks, source text or settings.
Warm latency cannot be reported as initial request latency.
